item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description: New: seven window backdrops — black sand, golden dune, pale sand, aurora, nebula, a ringed planet and cirrus cloud — each graded separately for light and dark appearance, so the window follows your Mac. The native macOS material stays the default and nothing changes until you pick one. New: clearer, more refractive Liquid Glass over a backdrop, on the dashboard cards and the menu-bar panel alike. Fixed: sheets never applied their Reduce Transparency fallback. Fixed: light-appearance legibility over a photographic backdrop.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description: New: at-a-glance system metrics on the Dashboard — overall load plus CPU, GPU, memory and disk, each with its real measurement. New: live system power draw on the Power card and in the menu-bar panel. New app icon. Fixed: a crash when opening the menu-bar panel. Fixed: fan-control helper setup could get stuck — Repair now rebuilds a stale registration. Improved: clearer temperature colours, and the panel fan slider now shows live RPM and reaches its true minimum. Plus a broad audit pass hardening the fan-control fail-safes.
